definitions.explanation: Miso made by combining two or more types (usually white and red, or rice and barley miso). Balances the flavors of each kind and is widely sold as a general-purpose miso.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made today's miso soup with blended miso.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クセ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Blended miso has less of a strong flavor and is easy to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白味噌|しろみそ}→白味噌：28917_shiromiso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{赤味噌|あかみそ}→赤味噌：28918_akamiso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}にした。
examples.english: I mixed white and red miso in equal parts to make blended miso.

notes:
The verb stem {合|あ}わせ ("combining") + ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧. Most miso sold in supermarkets is actually {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}, since pure single-type miso has a stronger character that not everyone prefers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}{仕立|じた}て: prepared with blended miso (on menus)
- ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}: homemade blended miso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白味噌|しろみそ}→白味噌：28917_shiromiso⟧: white miso — milder and sweeter
- ⟦{赤味噌|あかみそ}→赤味噌：28918_akamiso⟧: red miso — saltier and stronger; aged longer
